verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Sprinto's docs serve an llms.txt index at docs.sprinto.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). They also confirm markdown versions of doc pages (.md endpoints) that point back to that index, so an agent can be aimed at either. Entries quoted from the llms.txt itself show it carries per-page summaries usable by agents. missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus bundle, explicit first-party guidance on using the docs with agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
